name: Power Skip
setup: A 20-metre lane on grass or a court, cones at each end.
cues: Skip as high as you can off the floor, knee and opposite arm driving up.
Push the ground back and float forward into the next contact.
Drive the front knee up toward the wall ahead.

faults.fix: Push the ground back hard and hang in the air a beat longer.

faults.fault: Landing out in front with a straight leg
faults.fix: Paw the floor back under you as you land.

cautions: Plyometric: only once landings are quiet and stable. Count contacts, not sets.

name: Curve Run
setup: Cones in an arc (a quarter circle about 10 metres across) on a flat surface.
cues: Lean into the curve from the ground up, like a bike turning.
Push the ground away with the outside foot.
Quick, quiet contacts on the floor around the arc.

faults.fix: Lean in earlier and push the floor away with the outside foot.
Arrive at the arc already fast and hold the speed through it.

cautions: Full warm-up first; stop the set when the speed drops.

name: Split Step Reaction
setup: Ready stance at the middle of the space, cones marking the spots to reach.
cues: Small split step, then go where a partner points.
Split step as the play starts: a small hop to land ready on the floor.
Push the floor away toward the spot.

faults.fix: Small split step onto the floor, on the balls of the feet, before every move.

faults.fault: Crossing the feet on the recovery
faults.fix: Shuffle back with a gap between the shoes.
